events.credibility_reason: Known only from snippets; whether the drawings are planar (hence convex, as faces are triangles) is not confirmed by the record.

Claimed full resolution of a well-known conjecture at a networking conference outside the graph-drawing venues; 17 years with no engagement found; refereed graph-drawing work (Da Lozzo, D'Angelo and Frati 2016/2020; Nöllenburg et al. 2014; Wang and He 2012) and Wikipedia still call the conjecture open without citing it; the abstract does not even confirm the graph class or planarity.
Same as the companion paper: uncited landmark claim at an off-field venue, later specialist literature still calls the problem open, guarantee of the randomised algorithm unstated.
That the Halin drawings have every face convex and are Euclidean greedy is the researcher's reading of the abstract, not confirmed from the text.

why: Only one event falls after 26 January 2024 (Bekos et al. 2025), and it concerns outerplanar convex drawings with no greedy content, so scope none. All other events predate the snapshot. Weak, planar-only, non-Euclidean-metric, β-weak, rectilinear and 'generalized greedy' results are variants of the statement as the literature reads it (Euclidean, planar, convex faces). Triangulations (Dhandapani) and Halin graphs (2020) are cases, with doubts about whether convexity/planarity is established. The close call is Berchenko–Teicher: scope whole by their claim, but I mark both not_credible because several F10 signals coincide: a landmark claim, an off-field venue, 17 years of silence, and later refereed specialist papers on exactly this question still calling it open without citing it. The alternative was doubtful, under which a refereed-proceedings reading could make the problem open_stale. I rejected that because the specialist community's continued treatment of the problem as open outweighs one networking-conference acceptance.
doubts: The Berchenko–Teicher full texts were never read; if they do prove the full conjecture, the problem was settled in 2009. The frozen 2024 wording was not checked. In-window search was not a full arXiv sweep.
